Subject: Project update: revised delivery date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing with an update on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for the platform took longer to certify than the vendor originally estimated, and that certification step has pushed our schedule back by two weeks. All other workstreams remain on track, and the team is continuing development in parallel so that no further time is lost once certification clears.

Our revised delivery date is 14 April. We're confident this new date is achievable and have built in a short buffer to account for final testing once the integration is certified, so you can expect the same level of quality in the finished product.

Would you like us to schedule a call this week to walk through the updated timeline and discuss any downstream impact on your own launch plans? We appreciate your patience and will keep you closely updated as we approach the new date.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
